subject: Encryption operations attestation for Bridgewater Labs onboarding
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.g@bridgewaterlabs.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Bridgewater Compliance <compliance@bridgewaterlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding — request for KMS/HSM attestations and rotation schedule

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday — Bridgewater Labs is excited to move forward with Redwood for our inference workloads. Before we complete procurement, our security team has a short checklist they need filled out related to encryption and key management. High-level asks are:

- A short attestation describing where tenant master keys are stored (customer BYOK vs Redwood-managed).
- Recent HSM attestation or vendor statement of compliance (FIPS/SOC2 excerpts acceptable).
- A copy of your key rotation runbook and an example rotation timeline for a new tenant (we want to confirm emergency rotation procedures and rollback).
- Any automation or API endpoints you expose for key rewrap/wrap-key operations and a sample call.

Can you put these in a single packet (PDF preferred) and indicate when you can deliver? Bridgewater would like artifacts by EOD Friday to keep the onboarding timeline.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Platform Security — Bridgewater Labs
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.g@bridgewaterlabs.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding — request for KMS/HSM attestations and rotation schedule

Samir — thanks for the clear list and for moving quickly. We're happy to provide a consolidated packet. Quick notes / asks on our side:

- For the attestation: do you require a signed statement on company letterhead or will a PDF exported from our compliance portal suffice?
- For the rotation timeline: we'll include both scheduled rotation (monthly/quarterly profiles) and emergency rotation playbook. Which cadence is Bridgewater planning to adopt?
- We have an API snippet for key rewraps; is a curl + example payload OK, or do you want SDK examples?

Irene (Security) and Laura (Customer Ops) are looped to assemble the artifacts. We'll aim to deliver a single ZIP (PDF + CSV timeline + text attestation) by 2028-03-16 5pm PT. If you need it sooner, let us know and we can prioritize the attestation and HSM excerpt first.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.g@bridgewaterlabs.com>, dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding — request for KMS/HSM attestations and rotation schedule

Hi Samir — attaching the requested artifacts for Bridgewater onboarding. Bundle includes:

- redwood-kms-runbook-v3.pdf (concise runbook: rotation policy, emergency rotation steps, rollback checklist)
- rotation-timeline-2028-03.csv (example timeline for a newly provisioned tenant across 90 days)
- hsm-attestation-statement.txt (vendor attestation excerpt: FIPS 140-2 Level 3 controls, HSM vendor serial metadata redacted)

Summary highlights (TL;DR):
- Key custody: default is Redwood-managed KEK in our HSM cluster. For Bridgewater we can enable BYOK (tenant master key import) — customer key material never leaves your environment during import; wrap/unwrap performed by HSM key-material once imported.
- Rotation: scheduled rotation is supported and configurable (30/90/180-day windows). Emergency rotation flow includes immediate rewrap under a new KEK, throttled rollout, and a fast rollback that re-applies prior KEK if any issues detected.
- APIs: we included a sample rewrap API call in the runbook (curl + service-account JWT example).

See the attached runbook for play-by-play and the CSV for an example schedule. If you need signed/ notarized attestation we can route to legal and get a letter on Redwood letterhead — indicate who to send it to.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood-kms-runbook-v3.pdf (pdf)], [attachment: rotation-timeline-2028-03.csv (csv)], [attachment: hsm-attestation-statement.txt (txt)]

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Gupta <samir.g@bridgewaterlabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Bridgewater Compliance <compliance@bridgewaterlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding — request for KMS/HSM attestations and rotation schedule

Irene — this is exactly what we needed, thank you. A couple of quick clarifications before we close the loop:

1) For BYOK import, can you confirm the import uses an ephemeral wrapping key so Bridgewater private key material is never stored in plaintext on Redwood infrastructure? A single-line confirmation is fine for our auditors.
2) On the emergency rotation rollback: does the rollback require a manual operator step or is it automated via your orchestration? We need the SLA on rollback initiation (e.g., within 15 minutes of incident detection).

If you can reply with short answers to those two bullets, we'll mark the checkboxes on our side and proceed to contract signature. Also, please send the signed attestation letter to compliance@bridgewaterlabs.com (we will need one with a signature block).

Samir
